about: Living Roots Wine & Co. is the two-hemisphere winery of Sebastian and Colleen Hardy, founded in 2016. Seb is a sixth-generation South Australian winemaker; Colleen grew up near Rochester and met him while working a vintage in Australia. In late 2017 they opened Rochester’s only urban winery, in a historic factory building on University Avenue, making Finger Lakes whites and sparkling wines from local growers, including Colleen’s family’s Shale Creek Vineyard above Keuka Lake, alongside reds from the Hardy family’s Adelaide Hills vineyards.

Gewürztraminer is a pink-skinned, highly aromatic grape best known from Alsace, where it makes some of France’s most perfumed whites; “Gewürz” is German for spice. It ripens early and holds on to its fragrance in cool climates, which has made it a long-standing specialty of the Finger Lakes. Living Roots made this one in a richer style, built around the grape’s classic floral perfume and intense fruit, with the variety’s characteristic spice giving balance on the palate.
